purpose: Reviewed Unity Mod Manager loader identities for scripts/UmmLoaderContracts.ps1. A profile is an exact identity (version, SHA-256, MVID) of one genuine UnityModManager.dll with the record it came from. Identity is checked against one selected profile; API compatibility is checked separately against the reference binary itself. A profile is added only from a genuine binary or an existing repository record, never to make a check pass. No loader binary is stored in this repository.

declaredMinimum.note: Owner-selected support and compile baseline of 2026-11-23. Exact build inputs are pinned separately in scripts/loader-reference-pins.json. Profile identity and API checks do not establish native compatibility.

profiles.provenance: Inspected on 2026-11-23 from lib/net35/UnityModManager.dll in the genuine NuGet UnityModManager 0.31.1 package (archive SHA-256 05a82b66bc44d56d1246f146d16e9fa8f9a42c450c5bc334bcfa9efddbdb53c9). The DLL hash matches the existing Tabletop Rules Expansion and Cutscene Skip build pins. MVID, length and UI method tokens were read from PE/CLI metadata; this is not a Mounted Combat API-binding or native result.
